text:
toni: Heads-up: PR #5349 flagged inconsistent pagination examples for GET /v1/models. Some examples show `cursor` while others use `page_token`. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5349
ammar: I noticed that too. OpenAPI components/schemas/ListModelsResponse uses `next_cursor` but quickstart and SDK snippets show `nextPageToken`. Linter: example.keyMismatch -> expected `next_cursor`.
toni: Ugh. Which SDKs are affected? I recall JS client returns { nextPageToken } in the convenience pager.
lina: JS helper maps `next_cursor` -> `nextPageToken` for ergonomics, but canonical API docs should show the raw JSON key `next_cursor`. SDK READMEs can include a short note about mapping.
docs-bot: CI: examples/openapi/models-list.yaml sample failed schema validation. Also flagged a README snippet in sdk-js/README.md referencing `page_token`.
ammar: Proposed fix: 1) update OpenAPI examples to use `cursor` naming consistently (we chose `next_cursor` in schema). 2) Add a short migration paragraph on the reference page: "Older docs used `page_token` / `nextPageToken`; prefer `cursor` snake_case names in raw JSON." 3) In SDK snippets keep idiomatic names but add inline comment mapping to JSON keys.
toni: Should we pick `cursor` or `page_token`? The schema currently uses `next_cursor`, which feels clear. Let's standardize on `cursor` family (next_cursor, prev_cursor).
lina: Agreed. I'll update the SDK READMEs to include a one-liner: // Raw JSON: next_cursor. In JS: // SDK pager exposes nextPageToken for convenience.
toni: Example curl I'll push: ```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models?limit=20&cursor=abcd1234" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
``` And the response example: ```json
{
  "data": [{"id":"rwd-7b", "description":"..."}],
  "next_cursor": "efgh5678"
}
```
docs-bot: Automated suggestion: add a small migration note and a docs-lint rule to validate top-level pagination keys against schema.
ammar: I'll add the change to samples/openapi/models-list.yaml and update other examples (quickstart, API reference). Also adding a lint rule to catch `page_token` or `nextPageToken` in examples.
lina: Pushed branch lina/models-pagination-casing. PTAL @toni @ammar. I updated JS and Python snippets to include the mapping comment and left the SDK pager example using nextPageToken but with note.
toni: Nice. One more ask: add a single-line changelog entry: "docs: standardize list models pagination to use next_cursor and cursor query param; document SDK mappings"
ammar: Done. Also opened issue INFR-456 to ensure SDK release notes mention the mapping for this release.
docs-bot: Update: branch lina/models-pagination-casing passes docs-lint. Preview: https://deploy-preview-5349--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/models#get-list
lina: Merged after CI green. Thanks!
toni: Great catch, team. This should reduce confusion for new users.
